messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service=embeddings-eu-prod (P1) — 60s spike in 5xx from embedder pool eu-2. Metrics: 5xx rate 12% over last 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerbot: PagerDuty auto-ack attempted. No human ack yet. Escalating to primary on-call.

sam: On it. Acked in PD. Starting quickblast triage. Anyone else see customer reports yet?

olivia-j: no direct customer reports in support queue so far. Watching dashboards.

sam: Quick check: running `kubectl get pods -n embedder | grep eu-2` — a few pods OOMKilled around 02:17 UTC. Suspect memory regression from yesterday's quantize-change.

mike-oncall: copying runbook notes -> https://redwood.runbooks/embedder-failures. Suggest hot-swap to backup pool eu-1 and scale up standby. I'll coordinate the pool shift if Sam confirms.
\

dana-sre: FYI, we've got a pending Dedicated deployment with different quant config. Would avoid rolling that until we confirm root cause.

sam: Rolling traffic to eu-1 now (using fast-fallback policy). Command: `redwood route set --from eu-2 --to eu-1 --weight 100 --reason "5xx spike"` — initiating.

pagerbot: Routing change accepted by control plane. Traffic shift in progress. Expected convergence ~30s.

olivia-j: Dashboards show 5xx dropping to baseline on eu-1. Latency stable. No errors in customer-facing logs for last 90s.

sam: Good. Keeping eu-2 cordoned for postmortem. Captured perf traces and kv-cache snapshots. Will run bisection on the quant change in eu-2 images.

mike-oncall: Noting customer impact: brief degradation for some high-concurrency embedding requests (~2 min spike). Recommend PSAT flag to Growth: "short embed degradation, resolved by routing".

dana-sre: Also creating incident ticket and adding relevant tag: infra, embeddings, eu. I'll attach heap dumps from eu-2.

sam: Thanks. I'll stay on until handoff at 03:00 UTC. If anyone wants ownership after that, please ping here. :thumbsup:

olivia-j: I'll take the 03:00-05:00 follow-up window if needed. Please DM handover checklist when ready.

incidentbot: Incident INC12345 created and linked to PagerDuty. Severity set to P1. Runbook step state: containment=done, mitigation=in-progress.

sam: Closing loop — monitoring for 10 more minutes then will update incident state. Great work team.
